title: Prove duplicate accept, stale proposal, cancellation/restart, account switch, restore/export failure and revoked share behavior through real API adapters on two devices.
whatBuilt: Real typed device-adapter API (account x device session bound, explicit device identity, never inferred from a token)
ONE shared owning store (DeviceAdapterStore) implementing the run/project/sharing seams over a single append-only revision ledger with SHA-256 manifests
Adapter-level guards: restore/export re-digest and fail closed on tampered bytes; shareRevision enforces owner-only
Session close = account switch: every later call on that device is denied session_closed; a foreign account is denied not_owner everywhere

provenEndToEnd.duplicateAccept: same decision id replayed from device B converges to 'duplicate', no double-append (ledger stays at 1)
provenEndToEnd.staleProposal: new edit from device B moves the base revision; device A accept blocked base_revision_moved; nothing changed
provenEndToEnd.cancellationRestart: cancelled run yields no proposals (cancelled_run_no_proposal); a fresh run on the same project base restarts and accepts cleanly
provenEndToEnd.accountSwitch: closeSession denies every call (session_closed); different account on same device denied not_owner on save/accept/history; true owner still operates from device B
provenEndToEnd.restoreExportFailure: tampered stored payload fails export and restore manifest checks (export_integrity_failed), nothing corrupted is written; unknown revision/project fail closed
provenEndToEnd.revokedShare: owner revokes an accepted recipient -> view denied recipient_not_accepted on every device; revoked AI-proposal permission blocks a live accept (permission_revoked)

verification.deviceadapterCheck: npm run deviceadapter:check -> 7/7 tests pass (compile tsconfig.deviceadapter.json + node --test)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
notes: Two devices are explicit device sessions (device_a/device_b/device_c), not inferred fingerprints; this ticket proves the Build edge/deny behavior through the adapter API. Hosted/provider/load/privacy/commercial gates remain open — no such gate is claimed closed by this work.
